connections: The vertical_wall is fused to the top surface of the base_plate.
The four openings are subtracted from the vertical_wall, penetrating through its depth (Y-axis).
edit_rules: Changing ASSUMED_WIDTH scales the X dimension of the base_plate, vertical_wall, and the X positions of all openings.
Changing ASSUMED_HEIGHT scales the Z dimension of the vertical_wall and the Z positions of all openings.
Changing ASSUMED_THICKNESS scales the Z dimension of the base_plate and shifts the Z origin of the vertical_wall and openings.
Changing ASSUMED_DEPTH scales the Y dimension of the base_plate, vertical_wall, and the depth of all openings.
Changing opening dimensions scales the respective opening prisms.
